title: Ebara 1996 AF hydration at equilibrium in 0.15 M NaCl, inner vs outer

quantity.name: hydration
quantity.definition: water content (g H2O / g wet tissue) of AF test specimens at equilibrium after soaking in 0.15 M NaCl (pilot specimens)

source.authors: Ebara S, Iatridis JC, Setton LA, Foster RJ, Mow VC, Weidenbaum M
source.sample: 60 multiple-layer circumferential AF specimens, 15 per region (anterior outer AO, anterior inner AI, posterolateral outer PO, posterolateral inner PI), from the L3-L4 discs of 15 lumbar spines (autopsy, frozen -20 C), Thompson grade I-II

protocol.summary: Pilot specimens soaked in 0.15 M NaCl for up to 120 min; hydration reached 98 % of equilibrium within 30 min and stayed nearly constant (~2 % variation) for more than 90 min.
how_to_simulate: Free swelling of an AF specimen in 0.15 M NaCl to equilibrium
Report water content as g water / g wet tissue

extraction.check_notes: Caption: equilibrium hydration inner 88.5 +- 4.7 % (n=5), outer 82.5 +- 0.45 % (n=5). Region (anterior/posterolateral) not stated.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
